title: End of Day
narrative: By evening, the news has shifted. The 'civil unrest' has a new name: an unexplained outbreak of violent behaviour near the waterfront.
Three hospitals report unusual patient intake. The mayor's office has not commented.
You stand at your apartment window, watching the city. It looks the same. But it doesn't feel the same.

choices.text: Go to bed. You're overthinking this.
Stay up and gather supplies — just in case.
